name: Beautiful Teachers (EdTech)
tagline: Modernizing an EdTech platform with secure, observable services.
description: Contributed to the ongoing rebuild of Beautiful Teachers' core platform, focusing on backend, DevOps, and security improvements to help the product scale safely.
highlights: Refactored monolithic APIs into composable NestJS services with async queues for heavy operations.
Implemented role-based access control, secret rotation, and fleet hardening guidelines across environments.
Automated daily backups and restore drills, cutting recovery time objectives from hours to minutes.

name: Bazary (Hybrid e-commerce)
tagline: Production-grade e-commerce backend with CI/CD automation.
description: Built a marketplace backend that balances speed, reliability, and observability while following 12-factor principles.
highlights: Containerized Django/DRF stack with PostgreSQL, Redis caching, and task workers for order flows.
Implemented JWT-based authentication with refresh tokens, throttling, and audit logging for sensitive actions.
Set up GitHub Actions pipelines deploying to AWS Lightsail with smoke tests and health probes.

name: JournalHub API
tagline: Secure journaling platform with observability-first mindset.
description: Built JournalHub's API as a dedicated service with modern auth, validation, and traceable logging to support feature delivery.
highlights: Introduced declarative validation with Joi schemas and centralized error handling for consistent responses.
Implemented JWT authentication, refresh token rotation, and granular permission scopes for content access.
Shipped a lightweight frontend that consumes the API so reviewers can walk through key flows in the interactive demo.
Added structured logging, request correlation IDs, and log shipping via Winston for root-cause analysis.

name: GreenZTech
tagline: Database design for a supply chain verification platform.
description: Designed and implemented a scalable PostgreSQL schema for a supply chain verification platform. Integrated the database with Ethereum smart contracts to guarantee data authenticity and automated schema setup and indexing via Bash scripts while delivering backend integration documentation. Due to NDA, project details and code are private.
highlights: Modelled resilient relational schemas handling provenance, verification proofs, and audit trails.
Linked PostgreSQL data with Ethereum smart contracts to sign and validate critical events.
Authored automation scripts and integration guides that accelerated backend onboarding.

name: FluentFlow (OCR Translation)
tagline: OCR-assisted translation service with smart caching and secure APIs.
description: Developed a multilingual translation API that handles text, images, and PDF inputs while keeping costs predictable and endpoints secure.
highlights: Integrated Tesseract OCR with Google Translate APIs and fallback providers for resiliency.
Added multi-layer caching (Redis + CDN headers) that cut response latency by 40% on repeated jobs.
Implemented JWT auth, rate limiting, and audit logs streamed to ELK for monitoring.
